item.title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy.

item.tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

answer_sheet.Mark and style: A simple green sprout above the name; clean and unfussy.

must_haves: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.

style.prompt: Create a clean, minimal square logo for a plant shop named Little Sprout. Pure white background. Center a simple flat green sprout icon with two leaves and a short stem above the exact text "Little Sprout". The name is clearly legible in a simple, neat sans-serif font in matching green. Balanced spacing, generous white space. Flat vector-style design, just one green color and white. Nothing fancy: no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no border, no mockup, no extra decorations, no additional text.
